title: Appoint an Additional Director
description: Inducts a new director onto the Board between two AGMs, to hold office until the next AGM.

questions.label: How many clear days' notice was given for this meeting?
How many directors are present at this meeting?
Does the proposed director already have a DIN?

options.label: No — needs to be applied for

questions.label: Article of the AOA authorising appointment of additional directors

template.proposal: It is proposed to induct {{director_name}} as an Additional Director of the Company. {{director_name}}, ({{qualifications}}), having more than {{experience_years}} years of experience in the field of {{experience_field}}, has consented to act as Director of the Company.{{#if din}} Their Director Identification Number is {{din}}.{{/if}} The Board members discussed and approved the following resolution.
template.body:
"RESOLVED THAT the Board of Directors do and hereby take on record the Consent received in Form DIR-2 from {{director_name}}{{#if din}}, holding DIN {{din}},{{/if}} to act as Director of the Company.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT pursuant to the provisions of Section 161(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 read with the Companies (Appointment and Qualification of Directors) Rules, 2014, and in terms of {{article_number}} of the Articles of Association of the Company, {{director_name}} be and is hereby appointed as an Additional Director of the Company with effect from {{effective_date}}, to hold office as such until the conclusion of the next Annual General Meeting of the Company.

RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the Directors be and are hereby severally authorised to file the relevant e-form with the Registrar of Companies, {{roc_jurisdiction}}, and to do all such acts, deeds or things as are necessary to give effect to the above resolution, including making the necessary entries in the Register of Directors of the Company."
template.minutesGist: Meeting held on {{meeting_date}} at {{meeting_place}}. The Board noted the proposal to induct {{director_name}} as an Additional Director of the Company, noting their qualifications ({{qualifications}}) and {{experience_years}} years of experience in {{experience_field}}. The Board discussed and approved the resolution above.

din.meaning: The 8-digit Director Identification Number issued by the MCA.
din.tip: If the proposed director has no DIN yet, DIR-3 must be filed before this resolution can be acted on — note that as a follow-up.

article_number.meaning: The AOA clause that empowers the Board to appoint additional directors between AGMs.
